name: hashfuncs
description: Fast, deterministic, non-cryptographic hash functions — xxHash, MurmurHash3, RapidHash. For partitioning, sharding, cache keys, and probabilistic-filter inputs; not for security.

cta.title: Fast Hashing in SQL
cta.description: Install Hashfuncs to plug industry-standard non-cryptographic hashes into DuckDB queries. For digests, signatures, or anything adversarial, use the [crypto](/products/extensions/crypto) extension instead.

quickStart.title: 64-bit xxHash3 — recommended general-purpose default
quickStart.sql: SELECT xxh3_64(payload) AS h FROM events;

quickStart.title: Seeded for reproducible partitioning
quickStart.sql: SELECT xxh3_64(user_id, 42) % 16 AS partition FROM users;

quickStart.title: 128-bit hex digest (canonical xxhash byte order; matches Python xxhash.xxh3_128().hexdigest())
